===Disciplinary record===
Ramos holds multiple disciplinary records, for Real Madrid, the Champions League, La Liga, ''El Clásico'' and the Spain national team.<ref name="beast">{{cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37581851/sergio-ramos26-red-career-cards-not-even-close-all-record-held-beast |title=Sergio Ramos' 26 career red cards are not even close to the record held by 'The Beast' |publisher=ESPN FC |last1=Wright |first1=Chris |date=27 February 2020 |access-date=17 May 2020 |archive-date=28 February 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200228233437/https://www.espn.com/soccer/blog-the-toe-poke/story/4061614/sergio-ramos26-red-career-cards-is-not-even-close-to-the-all-time-record-held-by-the-beast |url-status=live }}</ref>

Ramos holds the record for the most carded player in La Liga, with 191 cards. His 171 yellow cards surpass that of [[Alberto Lopo]], the former record holder for La Liga yellow cards.<ref>{{cite web |title=Rankings Players First Division |url=https://www.bdfutbol.com/en/c/rankingTG1.html |access-date=5 June 2018 |archive-date=7 August 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200807045222/https://www.bdfutbol.com/en/c/rankingTG1.html |url-status=live }}</ref> The remaining 20 are red cards, making Ramos the most red-carded player in La Liga as well. His La Liga cards are higher than that of any other player in the [[Big Five (association football)|top five European leagues]].<ref name="records">{{cite web |last1=Chip |first1=Mister |title=Sergio Ramos has more cards than any other player in history in Europe's major leagues, the Champions League and the Spain team. |url=https://en.as.com/en/2018/02/24/football/1519467157_104328.html |website=AS.com |access-date=5 June 2018 |archive-date=30 January 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190130032746/https://en.as.com/en/2018/02/24/football/1519467157_104328.html |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In the Champions League, Ramos has amassed 40 yellow cards and four red cards (three of which were straight red cards), making him both the most carded player and joint most red carded player in Champions League history.<ref>{{cite web |title=Real Madrid's Sergio Ramos overtakes Paul Scholes for most UCL cautions |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37561872/real-madrid-sergio-ramos-overtakes-paul-scholes-most-ucl-cautions |publisher=ESPN |date=19 September 2018 |access-date=20 September 2018 |archive-date=20 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210720034614/https://www.espn.com/soccer/real-madrid/story/3639518/real-madrids-sergio-ramos-overtakes-paul-scholes-for-most-ucl-cautions |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Real Madrid's Sergio Ramos picks up 26th red card of his career against Manchester City |url=https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/real-madrids-sergio-ramos-picks-up-26th-red-card-of-his-career-against-manchester-city/ |website=CBS Sports |date=26 February 2020 |access-date=26 February 2020 |archive-date=18 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210718131701/https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/real-madrids-sergio-ramos-picks-up-26th-red-card-of-his-career-against-manchester-city/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

Finally, Ramos also holds the record for being the most carded player in the history of the Spain national team, with 24 yellow cards.<ref name="records"/>

==Personal life==
Ramos began a relationship with journalist/presenter [[Pilar Rubio]] in September 2012 and they were seen together at [[2012 FIFA Ballon d'Or|that year's Ballon d'Or ceremony]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://hemeroteca.mundodeportivo.com/preview/2005/03/27/pagina-4/1309544/pdf.html|title=Pilar Rubio y Sergio Ramos hacen oficial su relación en la gala del Balón de Oro|trans-title=Pilar Rubio and Sergio Ramos make relationship official at Ballon d'Or Gala|work=[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]]|language=es|date=9 January 2013|access-date=9 January 2014|archive-date=23 September 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180923103450/http://hemeroteca.mundodeportivo.com/preview/2005/03/27/pagina-4/1309544/pdf.html|url-status=live}}</ref> They have four sons together:<ref>{{cite web|url=http://futbol.as.com/futbol/2014/05/06/primera/1399406292_510711.html|title=Nace el primer hijo de Ramos|trans-title=Ramos' first son is born|publisher=[[Diario AS]]|language=es|date=6 May 2014|access-date=8 May 2014|archive-date=8 May 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140508223933/http://futbol.as.com/futbol/2014/05/06/primera/1399406292_510711.html|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Ramos' third son had to be born on... 'Ramos Sunday'!|url=http://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2018/03/25/5ab80b69e5fdea59478b4649.html|access-date=27 March 2018|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=25 March 2018|archive-date=27 March Ramos introduces his fourth child, Maximo Adriano|url=https://www.marca.com/en/football/real-madrid/2020/07/26/5f1de1cbe2704e4eaa8b45cb.html|access-date=26 July 2020|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=26 }}</ref>

Ramos has a close relationship with his family, especially his siblings and parents.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sergioramos.com/mis-pasiones/familia/|title=Familia – Sergio Ramos|language=es|access-date=30 March 2019|archive-date=30 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330032107/https://www.sergioramos.com/mis-pasiones/familia/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Rene, his brother, is currently his [[football agent]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://rr-socceragency.com/en/tag/rene-ramos/|title=Rene Ramos Archivos|website=rr-socceragency-en|language=es|access-date=30 March 2019|archive-date=19 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171219055226/http://rr-socceragency.com/en/tag/rene-ramos/|url-status=live}}</ref> and is married to singer [[Lorena Gómez]]. web|url=http://www.marca.com/2012/07/04/en/football/national_teams/1341433222.html|title=Bullfighter Talavante thanks Ramos for cape gesture|work=Marca|location=Spain|date=7 April 2012|access-date=17 Ramos is the second cousin of former footballer [[José Mari (footballer, born 1978)|José Mari]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.20minutos.es/fotos/deportes/ramos-jose-mari-y-otros-futbolistas-que-quizas-no-sabias-que-son-familia-14138/|title=Ramos, José Mari y otros futbolistas que (quizás) no sabías que son familia|work=[[20 minutos]]|access-date=11 November 2025|date=15 May 2018|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260330114805/https://www.20minutos.es/fotos/deportes/ramos-jose-mari-y-otros-futbolistas-que-quizas-no-sabias-que-son-familia-14138/|archive-date=30 March 2026|url-status=live}}</ref> Ramos is Catholic, and was baptised at the Parish Church of Nuestra Senora de La Moraleja in Madrid.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://e01-marca.uecdn.es/en/football/real-madrid/2019/05/14/5cdb1363ca474128228b4594.html|title=Sergio Ramos is baptised before his wedding with Pilar Rubio|first=En|last=Español|date=14 May 2019|website=E01-marca.uecdn.es|access-date=6 June 2026}}</ref>

===Body art===
Ramos has lots of [[tattoos]], including [[Jesus]], [[Mary, mother of Jesus|Mary]], the [[Star of David]], a lion, a wolf, a [[dreamcatcher]], the map of Spain, a [[Native Americans in the United States|Native American]] chief, the [[hamsa]], the FIFA World Cup and Champions League trophies and his family members.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/37575694/sergio-ramos-tattoos-stuffed-rabbit-football-pitch-tribute-banksy|title=Toe Poke Daily: Sergio Ramos' tattoos: stuffed rabbit, a football pitch, tribute to Banksy|date=20 August 2019|last=Wright|first=Chris|work=ESPN|access-date=5 June 2022|archive-date=5 June 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220605201455/https://www.espn.com/soccer/blog-the-toe-poke/story/3925150/toe-poke-daily-sergio-ramos-tattoos-stuffed-rabbita-football-pitchtribute-to-banksy|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://tribuna.com/en/blogs/sergio-ramos-reveals-striking-new-tattoo-placed-right-on-the/ |title=Sergio Ramos reveals striking new tattoo – placed right on the back of his head |publisher=Tribuna.com |date=30 November 2025 |access-date=1 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251130221142/https://tribuna.com/en/blogs/sergio-ramos-reveals-striking-new-tattoo-placed-right-on-the/ |archive-date=30 November 2025 |url-status=live }}</ref>

===Amazon Prime documentary===
In January 2019, [[Amazon Prime]] and Ramos himself announced they would release an eight-episode documentary series on Ramos's life in football and outside of football. It was named ''El Corazón de Sergio Ramos'' (''The Heart of Sergio Ramos'').<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/sergio-ramos-amazon-series-real-madrid-spain-football-1203123578/|title=Amazon Orders Documentary Series on Real Madrid and Spain Star Sergio Ramos|last1=Clarke|first1=Stewart|date=30 January 2019|website=Variety|language=en|access-date=2 February 2019|archive-date=5 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190405025719/https://variety.com/2019/tv/news/sergio-ramos-amazon-series-real-madrid-spain-football-1203123578/|url-status=live}}</ref> On 5 March, during Real Madrid's [[Champions League 2018-19|Champions League Round of 16]] second leg match, Ramos was suspended and watched the match from his VIP area in the stands. His reactions were filmed by the Amazon Prime crew.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/sergio-ramos-documentary-what-is-it-when-will-it-be-released-all-/ecdd6dgfautg1v30uvm7sjpmn|title=Sergio Ramos documentary: What is it, when will it be released & all you need to know|website=goal.com|language=en|access-date=30 March 2019|archive-date=30 March 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190330044447/https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/sergio-ramos-documentary-what-is-it-when-will-it-be-released-all-/ecdd6dgfautg1v30uvm7sjpmn|url-status=live}}</ref> This sparked controversy as Real Madrid lost the match and were eliminated from the Champions League, though Ramos said on social media that there were "certain commitments made and it never remotely went through my head that the game could have turned out as it did".<ref name="marca.com"/>

Due to the success of his first documentary series, Ramos announced in June 2020 on social media that Amazon would release another documentary known as ''La Leyenda Sergio Ramos'' (''The Legend of Sergio Ramos''), which consists of six episodes and shows his career highlights. It was released in Spain in April 2021 and was released worldwide in June 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|author=<!--Staff writer(s); no by-line.-->|title=The Legend of Sergio Ramos on Prime Video in 2021|url=https://advanced-television.com/2020/06/29/the-legend-of-sergio-ramos-on-prime-video-in-2021/|access-date=1 July 2020|website=advanced-television.com|date=29 June 2020|language=en-GB|archive-date=1 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200701095944/https://advanced-television.com/2020/06/29/the-legend-of-sergio-ramos-on-prime-video-in-2021/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Prime Video: The Legend Of Sergio Ramos|url=https://www.primevideo.com/detail/Sergio-Ramos/0S8257GNP4MTS4AKP06YP4KVIH|access-date=28 May 2021|website=Primevideo.com|language=en-us|archive-date=18 July 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210718131703/https://www.primevideo.com/detail/Sergio-Ramos/0S8257GNP4MTS4AKP06YP4KVIH|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Attempted acquisition of Sevilla===
In 2026, Sergio Ramos, alongside the investment group Five Eleven Capital, attempted to acquire a controlling stake in [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]]. Negotiations reportedly centered on a deal worth around €450 million, but collapsed after Ramos' consortium submitted a revised offer that reduced the purchase price and altered the ownership structure from an immediate majority acquisition to a smaller initial stake with a proposed future capital increase. Sevilla's shareholders rejected the revised terms and ended the negotiations.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-us/soccer/la-liga/articles/sevilla-rejects-sergio-ramos-takeover-after-changes-to-the-offer-and-breaks-off-what-seemed-to-be-a-progressing-deal-2026-05-28 |title=Sevilla rejects Sergio Ramos takeover after changes to the offer and breaks off what seemed to be a progressing deal |publisher=beIN SPORTS |date=28 May 2026 }}</ref>
